note: Enclosed (non-ocean-connected) water bodies to KEEP as water when generate_heightmap.py fills false inland water to land. Everything enclosed and NOT listed here (drawn rivers classified in ocean-blue, flooded marshes) fills to land; the open ocean is kept automatically as the single largest water component. Seeds are guaranteed-interior water pixels in provinces.png canvas space (x, y), measured from tools/derived/land_sea_mask.png (user-curated 2026-08-12 from tools/derived/dbg_lake_catalog.png). `kind` is `lake` (vanilla impassable-lake behaviour downstream in S3b) or `sea` (ocean-connected navigable sea zone, modelled like Ulthuan's Inner Sea in S3b); the binary mask keeps all of them identically as water, `kind` only records the S3b distinction. Hand-authored geographic data, like a registration seed: edit deliberately and regenerate, never hand-edit the generated bitmaps. See planning/done/world-map-regenerate-land-sea-mask.md.
